articles.title: US intelligence says Chinese satellite imagery of bases is helping Iran
articles.summary: US intelligence believes a Chinese company's AI-enhanced satellite images of US bases in the Middle East are assisting Iranian forces in identifying targets. This development raises significant concerns about the strategic implications of commercially available advanced AI and satellite technology being leveraged by adversarial nations for military intelligence, impacting regional security dynamics.

articles.title: Nitish to take oath as Rajya Sabha member on April 10: BJP
articles.summary: BJP announced that Nitish Kumar is slated to take oath as a Rajya Sabha member on April 10, marking a key political development in India's national landscape. Separately, Apple has released its iOS 26.5 public beta, introducing new features like 'Suggested Places' in Maps, signaling continued advancements in mobile technology for users.
